entries.name: Small benchmarks rarely resolve 3-5 point accuracy gaps
entries.summary: Simulation: on a binary-scored benchmark near 70% accuracy, a paired bootstrap 95% CI detects a true 5-point gap in only 13-19% of 100-item comparisons and 20-34% of 200-item ones (51-76% at 500 items). Median CI half-widths are 7.5-11.0 pp at n=100, 5.3-7.8 pp at n=200, and 3.4-4.9 pp at n=500.
